reason: The CIF parses, remains primitive P3, and symmetry-expands to 11 unit-occupancy atoms with the stated Ba3In2O6 composition and cell; the indexed metric also covers the important reflections. However, the instantiated coordinates are not a chemically valid oxide realization: complete periodic shells show In1 has no O neighbor closer than 5.385 A, while every Ba and In site forms a same-element chain at the 2.664 A c translation; bond-valence analysis correspondingly assigns both In sites as +1 with mixed -1/-2 oxygen rather than the charge-balanced Ba(II)/In(III)/O(-II) state. The trace's minimum-distance check missed periodic self-images and its coordinate refinement used local peak maxima rather than a whole-profile refinement. An independent profile comparison of this CIF gives RMS residual 0.268, materially above a free-intensity Pawley/profile bound of 0.158 and off-peak noise RMS of about 0.132. Thus good indexing and approximate intensity ordering do not establish the submitted atomic structure, and another attempt is likely to produce a materially different viable realization.
